newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MONDAY MIXED ON KEY UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MONDAY MIXED ON KEY UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar ended a quiet Monday session mixed on major currencies, unchanged on the U.S. dollar, stronger on the mark but weaker on sterling.

"Basically nothing happened on the interbank market. Those who were short and quoting rates a bit higher eventually went to those who had money so the Reserve Bank didn't do anything," one foreign exchange dealer said.
At Monday's close, the local dollar was quoted unchanged from its 10.7550/7750 late Friday position but weaker on sterling at 17.7100/7300 from 17.6880/7310.
It strengthened to 6.9300/9500 on the mark from 7.0190/0370 and on the rand to 2.2900/3100 versus 2.3060/3130.
